items.text: The Partnership states it seeks to address its strategic risks, including competition for clients and personnel in light of generational wealth transfer, through initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for clients, colleagues and communities.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values, technology, artificial intelligence, and regulatory changes, through its initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for millions of current and potential clients, colleagues and communities.

items.text: The Partnership states it is making significant investments in financial advisors and other human capital, technology infrastructure, digital initiatives, knowledge- and data-powered tools, and strategic relationships to support long-term growth objectives in light of generational wealth transfer.
items.quote: significant investments in financial advisors and other human capital, technology infrastructure, digital initiatives, knowledge- and data-powered tools, and strategic relationships to support long-term growth objectives and deliver enhanced value and impact for millions of current and potential clients

items.text: The Partnership describes initiatives to target new clients, including a High Net Worth segment, a Workplace segment, and a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors, plus recently launched Financial Planning Services.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones announced it has taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with the stated intention of integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Katherine Roy, principal, workplace and retirement solutions at Edward Jones, said the firm wants to create opportunities for advisors to serve business owners and pull that through the client lifecycle.
items.quote: We want to be able to create those opportunities for advisors and really pull that through the lifecycle.

items.text: The Partnership attributes a downward trend in net new assets partly to generational wealth transfers outside the firm, alongside an aging client base.
items.quote: Net new assets decreased by 10% compared to the second quarter of 2024, continuing a downward trend which can be attributed to higher asset outflows. These outflows are impacted by a variety of factors, including, without limitation, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm
